name: Perez
bio: Perez is one of the twin sons born to Judah and his daughter-in-law Tamar. During the delivery, the other child put out his hand first, and the midwife tied a scarlet thread around it to mark him as firstborn — but he drew his hand back, and Perez came out first instead. The midwife exclaimed, "How hast thou broken forth?" and so he was named "Perez," meaning "breach" or "breaking through" (Genesis 38:27-29). Perez's line carries major significance in Scripture — his descendants continue down through Boaz and Jesse to King David, and are recorded at the end of the book of Ruth and in the genealogy of Jesus Christ in Matthew 1 (Ruth 4:18-22; Matthew 1:3).
